We operate on a contingency fee basis, meaning you won’t pay your wildfire litigation lawyer anything unless your case results in financial compensation for your losses.
How Can a Wildfire Litigation Attorney Help?

You may have the right to financial compensation as someone who’s been affected by a Colorado wildfire. Unfortunately, it can be difficult to get the case results you deserve. Hiring an attorney ensures the protection of your rights when going up against defendants and their insurance companies.

Our attorneys can investigate the wildfire to collect evidence to bring against one or more negligent parties. We will accurately evaluate how much your case is worth and negotiate aggressively to achieve a fair settlement. If a settlement cannot be reached, we are fully prepared to litigate wildfire cases in court.
What Is the Basis of Most Wildfire Lawsuits in Colorado?

Uncontrolled wildfires in Colorado can result in significant physical injuries, psychological trauma, property damage and destruction, financial hardship, and the deaths of loved ones or beloved pets. At Dormer Harper, LLC, we believe victims should not have to pay for the damage suffered in wildfires.

Many wildfires in Colorado are preventable. Wildfire litigation often names power companies as defendants for their role in causing the blaze. In 2023, for example, Xcel Energy faced nearly 300 lawsuits for the role its power lines played in starting the
Marshall Fire
– the most destructive fire in Colorado’s history.

We can help you take a stand by filing a lawsuit against the party responsible for the wildfire. We can hold a utility company in Colorado accountable for its faulty equipment, for example. If an investigation determines that Xcel Energy, Black Hills Energy, United Power or another company caused or contributed to the fire that changed your life, we will help you file a claim.
